test_select_audio_effects: test select_audio_effects to choose a subset of audio augmentations using weighted or all mode
test_get_audio_effects: test get_audio_effects to build a dict of all available audio effect functions from config
test_audio_effects_speed: test the AudioEffects speed method to change playback speed of a batch of audio tensors
test_audio_effects_filters: test the AudioEffects lowpass, highpass, and bandpass filter methods on audio tensors
test_audio_effects_compression: test the AudioEffects mp3_compression and aac_compression methods to apply lossy compression to audio
